verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents its own 'context management that survives long sessions' for its terminal coding agent, and it gives developers access to the messages exchanged during a run. That gives thin, first-party support for keeping long conversations workable, but nothing shows how history is trimmed, summarized, or filtered. missing for 10: documented history processors or trimming/filtering APIs, a summarization mechanism, context-window or token-budget handling for general agents, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trim, summarize, or filter conversation history to keep an agent inside its context window

citations.quote: context management that survives long sessions
Pydantic AI provides access to messages exchanged during an agent run. These messages can be used both to continue a coherent conversation, and to understand how an agent performed.
